title: Jev query
description: A System One request as jevlint reads it: the state, and the questions asked about it. This is the request body, so a file that validates here is one you can send.

state.description: The material the questions are asked about. Jev accepts text only.

model.description: The build to send to. jevlint reads it but does not use it; --model decides what the checks themselves are asked through.

questions.description: Keyed by the id the answer comes back under. Ids are not sent to the model.

instructions.description: The question itself. A string, or an object or array putting the question in one field and the data it refers to in others.

criteria.description: A map of label to description for a choice, an ordered list of levels for a score, and an optional true/false pair for a noul. The choice and score shapes are inverse, and sending the wrong one is a 422.
